profit_quality.assessment: The company is a chip design and sales business with acceptable three-year aggregate cash conversion, but 2025 profit fell sharply and contains material non-operating or lower-quality items. The main denominator is therefore not reported parent net profit of HKD 235.356 million; it uses a conservative pre-haircut distributable cash profit of HKD 180 million and applies a 0.65 cash-profit haircut.
adjustments: Started from 2025 reported parent net profit of HKD 235.356 million rather than the higher 2023-2024 profit levels because revenue and gross profit declined sharply in 2025.
Discounted for HKD 51.515 million government grants, HKD 47.812 million interest income and HKD 43.202 million inventory provision reversal.
Checked cash conversion with 2023-2025 operating cash flow and capex: free cash flow after capex was HKD 803.167 million in 2023, HKD 184.066 million in 2024 and HKD 254.865 million in 2025.
2025 working-capital release supported operating cash flow, so the cash-flow evidence is not used to raise the denominator above a conservative current-cycle level.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2023-2025 operating cash flow was HKD 889.349m, HKD 274.412m and HKD 305.045m; capex was HKD 86.182m, HKD 90.346m and HKD 50.180m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: 0.65 reflects acceptable but uneven cash conversion, 2025 earnings downcycle, meaningful government grant/interest/inventory-reversal components, and the need for ongoing R&D and working-capital support.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Aggregate cash conversion is not the main weakness, but 2024 was poor and 2025 benefited from working-capital release.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Annual report does not split maintenance and growth capex; 2025 capex of HKD 50.180m is used as the current conservative cash deduction reference.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2025 released working capital from inventories and receivables, partly offset by lower payables and lower contract liabilities; normal reinvestment cannot be precisely separated.
